caption: The drawing features a geometric pattern composed of fabric swatches arranged in a diamond orientation against a plain, off-white background. At the center is a square of dark textured fabric, surrounded by a ring of alternating triangular segments. These triangles are made from three types of fabric: a brown fabric, a plaid or checkered fabric in gray and white tones, and a deep red fabric. The triangular segments together form a star-like pattern around the central square. The outermost layer of the composition is formed by large brown triangles at each corner, completing the diamond shape. The entire composition is symmetrical, and the colors primarily include shades of brown, black, red, and gray, with the checkered fabric adding a pattern contrast. A faint border surrounds the diamond pattern on the off-white background. There is small text at the bottom right with the name “Frank Maher” and at the bottom left noting a size dimension. The overall effect is of a carefully arranged quilt block or fabric study.
title: Quilt Block
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
